name: eBay
description: Global general resale marketplace. Sell almost anything — collectibles, electronics, clothing, home goods. Established buyer protection and large buyer base. Selling fees typically 10–15% depending on category.

name: Vinted
description: European second-hand fashion marketplace. No seller fees — the buyer pays a protection fee. Popular for clothing, shoes, accessories and home items. Strong UK presence.

name: Depop
description: Fashion resale platform popular with vintage, streetwear and designer sellers. Owned by Etsy. 10% selling fee plus payment processing.

name: Etsy
description: Global handmade and creative marketplace. Ideal for handmade goods, crafts, vintage items and personalised products. 6.5% transaction fee plus listing fees.

name: Gumroad
description: Digital product marketplace. E-books, courses, software, templates, memberships. Simple flat 10% fee, no monthly charges. Direct-to-audience selling.

name: Mercari
description: General resale marketplace popular in the US and Japan. Clothing, electronics, collectibles and household goods. 10% selling fee.

name: Poshmark
description: Fashion resale platform popular in US, Canada, Australia and India. Clothing, shoes, accessories and beauty. 20% fee on sales over $15.

name: Facebook Marketplace
description: Local and general resale marketplace built into Facebook. Furniture, electronics, vehicles, household items. Free to list, no fees.

name: Craigslist
description: Long-running local classifieds platform, primarily US. Local goods, furniture, services and vehicles. Free to list in most categories.

name: OfferUp
description: US-focused local resale app. Electronics, furniture, vehicles and household goods. Free to list with optional promotion fees.

name: Whatnot
description: Live selling platform for collectibles, fashion and trading cards. Stream live and sell to engaged audiences. Popular in US, UK and Europe. 8% commission.

name: Shpock
description: UK and European local second-hand marketplace. Buy and sell locally with a mobile-first approach.

name: Gumtree
description: UK classifieds and local resale platform. Furniture, electronics, vehicles, jobs and services. Free to list in most categories.

name: Preloved
description: UK second-hand marketplace and classifieds. Focused on local sales and community-driven listings.

name: OnBuy
description: UK/Europe e-commerce marketplace for new products. Competes with Amazon in the UK market. Sellers pay monthly subscription plus commission.

name: Not On The High Street
description: UK marketplace for gifts, handmade goods and creative products. Curated application process. 25% commission on sales.

name: Big Cartel
description: Independent online store platform for artists and creators. Simple storefront with low monthly fees. Free tier available.

name: Shopify
description: Leading e-commerce platform for building a full online store. Monthly subscription, payment processing fees and full storefront control. Free trial available.

name: Ko-fi
description: Creator support platform for digital products, memberships and tips. 0% platform fee on donations, 5% on shop sales. No monthly cost.

name: Payhip
description: Digital product platform for e-books, courses, memberships and software. Free tier available; 5% fee on sales. Good for solo creators.

name: Sellfy
description: Digital and physical product store. E-books, subscriptions, print-on-demand. Monthly subscription, no transaction fees on higher plans.

name: Creative Market
description: Digital design asset marketplace. Fonts, templates, graphics, photos and WordPress themes. 50% commission on sales, 40% for exclusive products.

name: Redbubble
description: Print-on-demand marketplace. Upload designs, Redbubble prints and ships to buyers worldwide. Artist earns a royalty per sale. Free to join.

name: TeePublic
description: Print-on-demand platform specialising in t-shirts and apparel. Upload designs, earn royalties. No upfront cost.

name: Zazzle
description: Print-on-demand and custom products platform. Mugs, shirts, cards, stationery and gifts. Design once, earn royalties forever.

name: StockX
description: Sneaker, streetwear and collectible marketplace with authenticated resale. Bid/ask model like a stock exchange. 9% seller fee on most items.

name: GOAT
description: Sneaker and fashion resale platform. Authenticated resale for sneakers, apparel and accessories. Popular globally for limited releases.

name: Vestiaire Collective
description: Luxury fashion resale marketplace. Designer clothing, handbags, watches and accessories. Authentication service included. 25% seller fee.

name: The RealReal
description: Luxury resale platform with in-house authentication. Consignment model — you ship items, they authenticate and sell. Commission 20–40% depending on value. Primarily US.

name: Grailed
description: Menswear and streetwear resale marketplace. Curated to higher-end fashion. 9% seller fee plus payment processing.

name: Vinted UK
description: UK-specific version of Vinted. Same zero-seller-fee model as the EU site but with UK-specific payment and shipping options.

name: Rebag
description: US luxury resale platform specialising in designer handbags, watches and jewellery. Authenticated resale with a strong reputation in the luxury sector.
